info.description:
## Introduction

Through our REST APIs, you'll be able to run an end-to-end capital program for your merchants. Specifically, you will:

  • Securely share data about your merchants and their transactions so that R2 can score them
  • Issue optimal financing offers for your preapproved merchants
  • Launch marketing touchpoints so that preapproved merchants learn about their financing offers
  • Send or capture specific data about a merchant to run R2's KYC process
  • Learn when a financing has been made along with its specific terms
  • Provide sales and/or repayment data on financed merchants
  • Retrieve updated balances
  • Renew financings

We have language bindings in Shell. You can view code snippets on the right-hand panel, and you can switch the snippets' programming language using the tabs above the code view.
To access our APIs, you need an access token. Please sign-up and get a new access token by registering at our developer portal.

metadata.description:
Metadata represents additional data in JSON format
	@Example	{"key1": "value1", "key2": "123"}

external_id.description: Unique identifier of the merchant to be created.

scenario.description: Name of the scenario to be created.

items.description: List of created offers. May contain nulls if some items fail to create.

repayment_rate.description: Repayment percentage for each transaction of the user.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the offer expiration.

amount_range.description: Range of amounts for the offers (used in `seed_offers`).

auto_approve.description: Auto-approve application (used in `seed_offers`). Only if `bypass_kyc` is true.

bypass_kyc.description: Skip KYC during the application (used in `seed_offers`).

default_pii.description: Use default PII for the application (used in `seed_offers`).

expires_in_days.description: Number of days until offers expire (used in `seed_offers`).

number_of_offers.description: Number of offers to be created (used in `seed_offers`).

term_days.description: Number of days until the financing is due (used in `seed_offers` and `financing_active`).

total_repayment_amount.description: Total repayment amount of the financing.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the application created.

financing_id.description: Unique identifier of the financing created.

repayment_rate.description: Percentage of merchant's sales deducted for repayment.
